content.title: How to watch Dodgers vs. Rockies: TV channel and streaming options for April 20
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers square off against the Colorado Rockies on Monday at Coors Field, at 8:40 p.m. ET. Justin Wrobleski (2-0, 2.12 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 15-6 this season and first in the NL West. Jose Quintana (0-1, 5.63 ERA) is starting for the Rockies, who are 9-13 and fourth in the NL West.How to watch Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Colorado Rockies Venue: Coors Field Time: 8:40 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: Rockies.TV and SportsNet LA Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. His OPS is 1.060, which ranks 3rd in MLB, and he has scored 12 runs. In 84 plate appearances, he has hit five home runs (20th in MLB) and driven in 21 runs (1st in MLB). Pages has been crafty on the base paths, recording three steals on four attempts. In 95 plate appearances, Kyle Tucker has hit three long balls, tallied 13 RBIs and scored 16 runs (19th in MLB). He is batting .256/.347/.390 and has posted a 21.1% strikeout rate and a 12.6% walk rate. Tucker has recorded three steals on three attempts. Mickey Moniak has hit six home runs this season, which ranks 12th in MLB. He has also tallied 12 RBIs and has scored 10 runs. In 59 plate appearances, he has recorded a .273 BA, .305 OBP and .655 SLG with a 5.1% walk rate and a 23.7% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. In 69 plate appearances, Troy Johnston has posted a 20.3% strikeout rate and a 7.2% walk rate while slashing .323/.382/.516 with two home runs, 10 RBIs and seven runs scored. He has stolen one base on two attempts.
